run_recipe_ingredient_training: run the inverse cooking model training loop on recipe images with ingredient and recipe decoding
merge_models_transfer_learning: merge a pretrained ingredient decoder from a transfer model into the current model for transfer learning
save_model_checkpoint: save the model state dict and optimizer state to disk with an optional suffix for best checkpoints
set_lr_decay: set the learning rate for all optimizer parameter groups by multiplying with a decay factor
count_parameters: count the total number of trainable parameters in a PyTorch model that require gradients
